description: This file defines a custom authentication failure handler for Spring Security, managing redirect or forward behavior upon authentication failure, including session exception storage.

classes.name: CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler
classes.description: A handler for managing authentication failure responses, supporting redirect or forward, and exception caching.

methods.name: onAuthenticationFailure
methods.description: Handles the failure event by redirecting, forwarding, or sending an error response based on configuration.

methods.name: saveException
methods.description: Stores the authentication exception in request or session scope depending on configuration.

methods.name: setDefaultFailureUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL to redirect or forward to upon failure, validating the URL.

methods.name: setUseForward
methods.description: Enables or disables forwarding to the failure URL.

methods.name: isAllowSessionCreation
methods.description: Checks if session creation is allowed when storing exceptions.

methods.name: setAllowSessionCreation
methods.description: Sets whether a session can be created for storing exceptions.
